name: rc12
description: The RC12 release: the re-derived configuration (dll/rederived.json), RC11's INT8 eligibility edit applied unchanged from the drop profile, and every exact C10 program: the hot slots' RC8/RC9 lowering carried to the 1080p and 8K context-size families of passes 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, prep and the final pass, each pinned by its recipe in dll/port/recipes. Own provider label. Built by dll/build.py --config rc12; checked by dll/port/rc12.py; packaged by scripts/package-dll.py.

notes.final-pass-divisions: As the base derives them: the SDK's sdiv stays in every final-pass program, including the C10 programs of 0x5e7990 and 0x7abdd0 (built from the SDK without RC9's half shift). A logical shift would be exact only for in-spec input: the host copies the caller's upscaleSize (uint32) into the divided fields unchecked, so a component >= 2^31 gives a negative dividend (every such dispatch is empty or exceeds D3D12's group-count limit). AMD's division is kept; on the BC250 its cost is within measurement noise (+0.002 +/- 0.001 ms at 1440p Performance, GPU check of 2026-10-23).
notes.int8-eligibility: Applied unchanged from the drop profile: RC11's 18-byte edit (RC7-RC11), whose bytes equal the third-party 4.1.1b DLL's host-code change. The base leaves it pending because the independent re-derivation did not complete; the edit is kept for RC12 by decision (2026-10-24). Provenance: dll/notices/PROVENANCE.md.
